lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Good morning, welcome to Riverside Cycle Hire.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Hello. We would like to hire two bicycles for tomorrow, please.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: A standard bicycle costs ten pounds for the whole day, and an electric bicycle costs eighteen pounds.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: We will take two standard bicycles, please.

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: You will need to leave a deposit of twenty pounds for each bicycle.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: That is fine. What time do we have to bring the bicycles back?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Please return them by five thirty. Actually, in summer we stay open later, so you can bring them back by seven thirty.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Seven thirty. That is good. Is a helmet included in the price?

lines.speaker: Assistant
lines.text: Yes, helmets and a repair kit are included in the price.

lines.speaker: Man
lines.text: Thank you. We will collect the bicycles at nine tomorrow morning.

sentences.text: In the hills of the north, the nearest public library may be twenty kilometres away, so the library comes to the villages instead.
A converted bus, painted bright yellow, carries about two thousand books to twelve villages on a fixed route.
The bus visits each village once every two weeks and stays for about two hours.
Most users are older people and young children, who would find the journey to the town library difficult.
As well as books, the bus carries DVDs and offers free internet access through a satellite connection.
Local businesses help to pay for the service by sponsoring the fuel for the bus.
Last year, the mobile library lent more books than in the year before, despite the growth of e-books.
The driver, who is also a trained librarian, says the visits are as much a social event as a chance to borrow books.
